title: Laredo City Council Meets Monday, Nov. 16: Utilities Report, Federal Project Talks and Scooter Rules on the Agenda
excerpt: The Laredo City Council meets Monday, Nov. 16, at 5:30 p.m. On the agenda: a proposed monthly Utilities Performance and Accountability Report, a resolution asking the state to step into negotiations over a proposed federal infrastructure project, and possible rules for the safe operation of electric scooters and bicycles in Laredo.
content:
The Laredo City Council will meet on Monday, Nov. 16, at 5:30 p.m., the City of Laredo announced Saturday morning.

Among the items on the agenda is the proposed creation of a monthly Utilities Performance and Accountability Report, according to the city.

Council members will also consider a resolution requesting state intervention in ongoing negotiations regarding a proposed federal infrastructure project, the city said.

Another item under discussion is potential regulations to promote the safe operation of electric scooters and bicycles throughout Laredo.

The city said these are just a few of the items scheduled for discussion as city leaders continue addressing community needs and priorities. The full posted agenda is available through the city's Legistar page.

Residents can attend the meeting in person or watch it live on Spectrum Channel 1300, on YouTube at @PublicAccessChannel1984, or on Facebook at City of Laredo – Government.

Source: City of Laredo - Government, Nov. 14, 2026.
